name: anzelu-loan
description: Anzelu — multi-tenant loan management platform (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @anzelu/contracts && npm run build -w @anzelu/finance
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @anzelu/api && npm run build -w @anzelu/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @anzelu/api" "npm run dev -w @anzelu/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w @anzelu/api" "npm run start -w @anzelu/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @anzelu/finance && npm run test:e2e
